facts: Katsu Kawasaki began the reconstruction in 1932. The standing reconstruction was completed in October 1935.
The three-tier timber main keep is 23 metres high above its masonry base. The small keep is 9.54 metres high.

record: Iga City Board of Education site record
facts: The 1935 keep occupies an original stone platform. The broader moat and high west walls predate the reconstructed keep.
